title: Gunshot
blurb: One clean crack with the reverb trimmed off. The standard-issue bang for action edits, western standoffs and the start of a race. Editors reach for it constantly because it does something no other sound quite manages — it hard-cuts a scene. Everything before it is one thing and everything after is another, with no explanation required. Use it for dramatic exits, startle cuts, and the audio equivalent of a full stop landing mid-sentence. Sharp, professional, no echo baggage attached. Handle it with the care you would give any full stop.
origin: A clean single gunshot for edits and dramatic punctuation.
